title: Exploration d'architectures neuronales profondes pour l'évaluation du risque ordinal
summary: A course project (GLO-7030) benchmarking deep learning architectures against gradient-boosting baselines for 8-level ordinal life-insurance risk assessment on the Prudential Kaggle dataset, including a synthetic tabular data augmentation strategy. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are trained per risk class to generate synthetic rows, with SingleTableMetadata and sdmetrics' QualityReport used to evaluate the generated data.
evidence: ctgan/generate_strategy_b.py: 'return CTGANSynthesizer.load(...)'; tvae/generate_strategy_b.py: 'return TVAESynthesizer.load(...)'; evaluation/evaluate_generators.py imports sdmetrics QualityReport
